# FPSOT procurement specification

> Rules for FPSOT clause packs and draft clause modules for public tenders: cite a versioned FPSOT specification and its conformance classes, always "or equivalent", never a product; conformance statement plus machine-readable suite report as evidence; a readiness rule before any spec-specific pack; a public register of conformance results; neutrality (FPSOT bids on no tender); nine bilingual draft modules under CC BY 4.0 with Québec RCTI, Québec LCOM and federal variants. Not legal advice.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts, the two licenses, conformance.
- [Clause packs](spec/en/packs.adoc): PRC-001 to PRC-009.
- [Clause modules](spec/en/modules.adoc): PRC-010 to PRC-019.
- [The drafting rule](spec/en/drafting.adoc): PRC-020 to PRC-028.
- [Content of the modules](spec/en/content.adoc): PRC-030 to PRC-039.
- [Readiness and results](spec/en/readiness.adoc): PRC-040 to PRC-046.
- [Neutrality](spec/en/neutrality.adoc): PRC-050 to PRC-052.
- [Routes to market](spec/en/routes.adoc): informative.
- [Questions for counsel](spec/en/counsel.adoc): informative, not legal advice.
